name: std-book-reader
description: std-book-reader — reads a multi-chapter book one chapter at a time. Opens on a cover (cover image, title, subtitle, author, a start button and the table of contents); reading shows a contents rail with the current chapter marked, the chapter title and progress, the chapter text (markdown) and previous/next buttons. Supports right-to-left books. Emits CHAPTER_OPENED on every chapter change. Pick for handbooks, manifestos, course readers and long-form guides.
